items.//: Every key is listed in `required` because OpenAI structured outputs demand it — a key in `properties` that is not in `required` is rejected outright. rloop's own document schema treats id/path/line/body as optional, so the provider strips the empty ones before printing; see the jq filter in codex-review.sh.

id.description: Stable slug naming the DEFECT, not the sentence about it. Must be identical across runs for the same defect — it is what a dismiss: entry matches on.

line.description: Line number as a string, or "". Converted to a number by the provider.
